沮.def: to stop, to prevent; dejected, defeated

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 且 (altar) as the sound: first a river name, then 'to stop'; later 'dejected'.

沮.name: dejected

origin.says: 广 (building with a roof) for the meaning plus 郎 (young man) as the sound: a covered corridor or porch.
Simplified from 嶄: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 斩 (to chop) as the sound: steep, as if cut off. Now mostly 'brand new, outstanding'.
Simplified from 蘿: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 羅 (bird net) as the sound: creeping plants, now radish (萝卜). It uses the simplified 罗.
分 (divide) as the sound over 皿 (dish, vessel) for the meaning: a wide basin, pot or tub.
火 (fire) for the meaning plus 臽 (pit) as the sound: flame.

淹.def: to drown, to immerse, to steep

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 奄 (to cover) as the sound: water covering over, to drown or soak.

淹.name: drown

缔.def: to tie, to join; knot, connection

origin.says: 纟 (thread) for the meaning plus 帝 (emperor) as the sound: a knot, to tie together, to conclude a treaty. Simplified from 締 (the silk side became 纟).

缔.name: tie knot

蔑.def: to disdain, to disregard, to slight

origin.says: A person drawn with eye and eyebrows (now like 艹 over 罒) struck by 戈 (dagger-axe): to wipe out, then to slight, disdain. The person and the axe fused into a shape like 戍 (guard).

蔑.name: disdain

origin.says: 此 (this) as the sound plus 木 (wood) for the meaning: firewood.

ety.hint: A curtain or towel hanging from a rack

origin.says: A drawing of a piece of cloth hanging down: cloth, towel, kerchief.

巾.name: towel
巾.in: 市常布带师希帮席帝币幕幅刷怖饰闹狮帜砸帅帐棉稀帽吊锦滞缔佩筛帆绵帘幢柿蒂帕帚涮帖蹄帷啼幌

origin.says: In oracle bones a picture of a two-headed dragon arching across the sky. Later rebuilt as 虫 (insect, creature) for the meaning plus 工 (work) as the sound: the rainbow.
力 (strength) for the meaning plus 员 (member) as the sound: great deeds done by effort, merit. Simplified from 勛 (員 to 员).
禾 (grain) for the meaning plus a sound part: young, unripe grain, so childish. The sound part was first 屖; in Han times it was commonly replaced by 隹 (short-tailed bird).

晃.def: bright, dazzling; to shake, to sway

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 光 (light) as the sound: dazzling sunlight; also to flash past, to sway.

晃.name: flash past

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 旨 (aim; first delicious) as the sound: animal fat, grease.

捆.def: to bind, to tie, to truss up; a bundle

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 困 (hemmed in) as the sound: to tie up by hand, a bundle.

捆.name: truss

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 奇 (strange) as the sound. First the name of a tree; later used for a wooden seat to lean back on (from 倚, to lean): a chair.

ety.hint: Twenty 廿 days ago 日

origin.says: 日 (sun, day) under a top part: one reading takes the top as strips of meat drying in the sun (the old word for dried meat), another as the sound part or as many past days. The meaning is former times.

昔.name: bygone days
昔.in: 错借措籍惜腊猎蜡藉醋鹊

ety.hint: A hand 又 grasping an object 丶

origin.says: 又 (hand) with a dot between the fingers, marking something held or the spread fingers: a fork, prongs, to cross.
玄 (cord) over 田 (here a bag of feed or an enclosure, not a field): one reading sees a tied feed bag, another animals tied in a pen. First to raise animals, then the animals raised, livestock.
Simplified from 遼: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 尞 (bonfire) as the sound: far away, distant. The sound part was replaced by the simpler 了 (finished).
米 (rice) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound: sticky, glutinous rice, hence sticky.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 其 (basket) as the sound: wooden game pieces, chess or any board game. It also replaces the variant 碁 (with 石 stone).

赠.def: to bestow, to confer, to present a gift

origin.says: Simplified from 贈: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 曾 (once before) as the sound: to present a gift. 貝 became its cursive shape 贝.

赠.name: gift

ety.hint: A crack on an oracle bone

origin.says: A drawing of the crack that appears on a heated bone or shell, read as an answer from the spirits: to divine. Also used as the simplified form of 蔔 (radish).

卜.name: oracle crack
卜.in: 外处补赴扑盐卧仆朴卦褂

鄙.def: rustic, vulgar; to despise, to scorn

origin.says: 啚 (border town, a granary drawing) for the sound and meaning plus 阝 (city): a border town, the backwoods, hence rustic, vulgar, to despise.

鄙.name: rustic

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 官 (official) as the sound: a wooden coffin.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 者 as the sound: the heat of the sun, summer.
矢 (arrow) for the meaning, a short measure of length, plus 委 (bent) as the sound: short, low in height.

ety.hint: A curled-up 卷 person 亻; 卷 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 卷 (to roll up, bend) as the sound and hint: a person curled up with fatigue, weary.
Simplified from 欖: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 覽 (look over) as the sound, now 览: the olive tree, as in 橄榄 (olive).
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 敢 (dare) as the sound: part of the word for the olive (in Chinese a similar fruit tree).

吞.def: to absorb, to annex; to engulf; to swallow

origin.says: 天 (sky) as the sound plus 口 (mouth) for the meaning: to swallow whole.

吞.name: swallow

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 奂 (grand) as the sound: an illness of numb, paralysed limbs. Simplified from 瘓 (奐 became 奂).

羡.def: to envy, to covet; to admire, to praise

ety.hint: Someone who has a whole row 次 of sheep 羊

origin.says: From 羨: 羊 (sheep, mutton) over 㳄 (drool): drooling for mutton, so to covet, envy. The modern form writes the bottom as 次 (next).

羡.name: envy

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 旁 (beside) as the sound: first the sound of falling stones; now used for the English 'pound' weight and a scale.
疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 难 (difficult) as the sound: the illness of paralysis. Simplified from 癱 by the same change as 難 → 难.
竹 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 逢 (meet) as the sound: a bamboo mat cover, an awning, a boat's sail.

爵.def: noble; a feudal rank or title

ety.hint: A hand 寸 holding a goblet 良 of wine 罒

origin.says: A drawing of a bird-shaped wine vessel, often held by a hand now written 寸 (hand). Its top and middle broke into 爫 (claw) and 罒 (net). Such cups marked rank, hence a noble title.

爵.name: noble rank

origin.says: 犭 (animal) for the meaning plus 侯 (marquis) as the sound: the monkey.

疏.def: to neglect; to dredge, to clear away; lax, careless

ety.hint: Walking 疋 through uncultivated land 㐬

origin.says: 𤴔 (a form of 疋, foot) as the sound plus 㐬 (a newborn with flowing water) for the meaning: water flowing freely, to clear a channel; hence sparse, loose, neglectful.

疏.name: dredge

origin.says: From 趙: 走 (walk) for the meaning plus 肖 (resemble) as the sound; used for an ancient state and a surname. The simplified form replaced 肖 with the simple mark 乂.

ety.hint: A monster with a scary head 田

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms show a ghost holding a stick, a fearful sight: to dread. One reading takes the stick as meaning and the ghost as sound. The stick later turned into other strokes, so the bottom no longer shows either part.

勾.def: to hook, to join, to connect; to entice

origin.says: A variant of 句 (hook; sentence), whose inner 口 (mouth) was written as 厶: a hook, to hook or tick off. The modern shape no longer shows the old build.

勾.name: tick mark

origin.says: A drawing of a cave entrance or a hut's door flap: cave, den, hole.

穴.name: den
穴.in: 究空控突穿穷窗挖窝窃窄腔帘窜榨窍窒窑窖窘窥窟窿

噪.def: to be noisy; to chirp loudly

ety.hint: The sound 口 of birds chirping 喿; 喿 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: First written 喿 alone: three mouths 品 (many mouths) on a tree 木 (tree), birds chirping. 口 (mouth) was added later; 喿 also gives the sound: noisy chatter.

噪.name: noise

捧.def: to hold or offer with both hands

ety.hint: An offering 奉 made with two hands 扌; 奉 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 奉 (offer up with both hands) as the sound: to hold in cupped hands.

捧.name: cupped hands

熬.def: to boil, to simmer; to endure pain

origin.says: 敖 (roam) as the sound plus 灬 (fire) for the meaning: to cook long over a fire, to simmer; then to endure.

熬.name: simmer

ety.hint: A building 宀 made out of wood 木

origin.says: 宀 (roof) over 木 (tree, wood), but how this gives the name of a state and dynasty is unclear; it may be a loan for a similar-sounding word.
A drawing of two wings or feathers side by side.

羽.name: feather
羽.in: 翻翰翼耀谬煽扇翘塌翔翅翁蹋戳翩嗡寥翠

晋.def: to advance; to increase; to promote

ety.hint: An advance to the second 亚 day 日

origin.says: Two arrows 臸 (to arrive) above the sun 日 (sun): arrows reaching a target, to advance. The arrow pair is now written like 亚 (second).

晋.name: promote

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 林 (grove) as the sound: covetous, greedy.

膜.def: membrane, film; to kneel and worship

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 莫 (do not) as the sound: a thin skin in the body, a membrane or film.

膜.name: membrane

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 户 (door) as the sound: jealous. An old view held it a corrupt form of 妬, with 石 (stone) as the sound.

遮.def: to cover, to protect, to shield

origin.says: 辶 (road, walking) for the meaning plus 庶 (multitude) as the sound: to block the way, hence to cover, to shield, to hide.

遮.name: block view

蓄.def: to store, to save, to hoard, to gather

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 畜 (to raise) as the sound: to grow and gather crops, to store grain, to save up.

蓄.name: hoard

逛.def: to ramble, to stroll, to wander

origin.says: 狂 (wild) as the sound plus 辶 (walking) for the meaning: to walk about freely, to stroll.

逛.name: stroll

捏.def: to knead, to mold, to pinch

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 圼 (black mud) as the sound: to knead or pinch, like shaping mud by hand. The packet's Wiktionary text is about a modern internet use, not the glyph.

捏.name: pinch

攀.def: to climb, to hang on, to pull up

origin.says: 樊 (fence) as the sound plus 手 (hand) for the meaning: to pull oneself up by the hands, to climb.

攀.name: climb

origin.says: 月 (flesh, body) for the meaning plus 桼 (lacquer) as the sound: the knee. An older form used 卩 (kneeling person) as the meaning part.
Simplified from 磚: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 專 as the sound, written 专: a brick, a stone-like block.
耒 (plow) for the meaning plus 井 (well) as the sound: to plow the field.

汁.def: juice, liquor, fluid; sap; gravy, sauce

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 十 (ten) as the sound: juice, liquid, sauce.

汁.name: juice

栽.def: to cultivate, to plant, to tend

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 𢦏 (a sound part built from 才 and 戈) as the sound: to plant trees.

栽.name: set seedlings

ety.hint: The sun 日 baking a desert 干; 干 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 干 (dry) as the sound, which fits too: sun that dries the land, drought.

ety.hint: Violent 暴 water 氵; 暴 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 暴 (violent) as the sound: water crashing down, a waterfall.

呵.def: to scold; to yawn; the sound of someone laughing (when repeated)

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 可 (can) as the sound: breathing out from the mouth, to scold, to yawn, or the sound of laughing.

呵.name: huff

莎.def: a kind of sedge grass that used to be woven into raincoats

origin.says: From 懇: 貇 as the sound plus 心 (heart) for the meaning: sincere from the heart. Simplified by dropping part of 貇, leaving 艮 (stubborn) over 心.

佩.def: belt ornament, pendant; wear at waist, tie to the belt; respect

ety.hint: Common 凡 cloth 巾 ornaments worn by people 亻

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 凡 and 巾 (cloth): a sash hung from the belt; the role of 凡 is unclear. Now also to admire.

佩.name: belt pendant

溜.def: to slip, to slide, to glide; slippery

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 留 (stay) as the sound: first a river name, now to slip and slide as water does.

溜.name: slide

颂.def: to laud, to acclaim; ode, hymn

origin.says: 公 (public) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: first 'appearance', later a hymn of praise. Simplified from 頌, with 頁 written 页.

颂.name: ode

ety.hint: A leader 尹 giving orders 口

origin.says: 尹 (official, a hand holding a staff) plus 口 (mouth): the one who gives orders, a ruler or lord. One reading takes 尹 as the sound and 口 as mere decoration.
